PLAN
1. List the directory structure and read the files named in the task, specifically focusing on `app/src/main/java/com/klondike/game/Game.kt` and `app/src/test/java/com/klondike/game/GameTest.kt`.
2. Ensure that the project is set up to run tests offline by using the `--offline` flag with Gradle commands.
3. Implement the `deal()` method in `Game.kt` according to the rules specified in the comments and tests in `GameTest.kt`.
4. Run the tests to verify that the `deal()` method works correctly.
5. Implement the `draw()` and `recycle()` methods in `Game.kt` according to the rules specified in the comments and tests in `GameTest.kt`.
6. Run the tests again to ensure that the `draw()` and `recycle()` methods are implemented correctly.
